faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Cut-Out Hollow Zinc Alloy Sports Medals?
faqs.answer: The starting wholesale MOQ for Custom Cut-Out Hollow Zinc Alloy Sports Medals is 300 pcs. Reference factory-direct tiered pricing is $2.65/pc (300 pcs starter tier), $1.72/pc (500 pcs tier), and $1.25/pc (2,000+ pcs volume tier), depending on size and finish complexity.

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Cut-Out Hollow Zinc Alloy Sports Medals, and when is it waived?
faqs.answer: Tooling policy for Custom Cut-Out Hollow Zinc Alloy Sports Medals is $120 Cut-Out Mold (Waived @ 1k). Every client receives custom steel tooling cut strictly to their artwork, stored free of charge for 3 years in our Zhongshan mold vault so subsequent reorders pay $0 mold fees.

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Cut-Out Hollow Zinc Alloy Sports Medals?
faqs.answer: Custom Cut-Out Hollow Zinc Alloy Sports Medals is custom-engineered from Die-Cast Zamak #3 Zinc Alloy using Multi-Window Hollow Cut-Outs + 3D Relief, sized around Ø76×3.8mm (3.0") at approximately 96g per unit (custom dimensions available).

faqs.question: Which electroplating colors and surface finishes are available for Custom Cut-Out Hollow Zinc Alloy Sports Medals?
faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include Antique Bronze / Matte Black / Gold. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.answer: Yes. Send your vector logo (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, or vector .PDF) or rough sketch via our quote form or WhatsApp, and our engineering team will send a free 1:1 scaled digital production proof within 12 hours.

faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production physical samples take 7–10 business days (paid sample covers custom mold cutting to your design, plating, and enamel finishing; courier air freight is billed at carrier cost or via your DHL/FedEx account).

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Cut-Out Hollow Zinc Alloy Sports Medals?
faqs.answer: Mass production for Custom Cut-Out Hollow Zinc Alloy Sports Medals completes in 10–14 Days after digital artwork proof or physical sample approval, followed by multi-point pre-shipment inspection for color accuracy, plating luster, and attachment security.

faqs.answer: Yes. All raw metals, electroplating baths, and Pantone enamel pigments comply with US CPSIA (<90 ppm lead), California Prop 65, and EU REACH / EN 1811 nickel-release regulations.
